{{Top|leg}}
The '''Induparan Prefecture''' was an organization operating in the [[Induparan Crown Worlds]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. The organization was copied in on several communications between [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Mirash Peet]] and [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Irnst Stavveld]] regarding increased [[Pirate/Legends|piracy]] in the region.<ref name="PP">''[[Pirates & Privateers]]''</ref>
